backup.title: Database Backup
backup.subtitle: Safely stores a copy of the current database state.
backup.about.title: About Database Backup
backup.about.text1: Database backups create a safe copy of all inventory data, including components, categories, and configuration.
backup.about.text2: Backups are useful before major changes such as updates, bulk edits, or refactoring, and allow data to be restored if something goes wrong.
backup.about.text3: This process does not affect daily usage and can be performed at any time.
backup.error.failed: Database backup failed. Please try again.
